name: Be Happy

passive_description.localized: Restores wearer's HP by <lv>{0}</> upon defeating an enemy. Triggers at most once every <lv>{1}</>s.
passive_description.source: 装备者击杀敌人时，回复自身<lv>{0}</>生命值，<lv>{1}</>秒内最多触发一次。

tested_hypotheses: The wearer alone receives credit for a delivered alive-to-dead target transition; teammate defeat does not heal the wearer.
Delayed native Skia Normal damage retains its actor ownership and can heal its owner after a field switch.
Zero/nonfatal delivery and an unequipped weapon do not heal; defeated targets do not receive another delivery.
Legal native T2 zero-modifier oracle: MaxHP 25 x 7/50 = 3.5 base HP; nearest-integer settlement yields 4.

Synthetic reached-callback oracle: exact base 3.5 with one 20% live bonus is 4.2 and rounds to 4; rounding base first would produce 4.8 and incorrectly settle to 5. Direct callbacks cover each modifier, both bonuses, strict missing/accepted behavior, and the shared report-assumption merge boundary. Public character/gear content currently has no supported healing-modifier producer.

Native Skia kill tests cover a full-HP trigger trace. A separate callback lifecycle harness calls the actual defeat handler and heal callback to test cooldown reservation at full HP, duplicate same-time target indices, just-before/exact deadline, and wearer-local cooldown state.

ProcCallback ordering applies the heal after lethal hit settlement. These trigger, cooldown, off-field, and rounding boundaries are explicit tested hypotheses. Frozen package evidence does not establish Global release availability.
